title: 價格與付款
description: 詢問價格與付款相關用語

sentences.en: Could you tell me how much this item costs, including tax, before I decide whether or not to purchase it?
sentences.zh: 你能告訴我這個東西含稅多少錢嗎？在我決定要不要買之前。

sentences.en: I was wondering if you accept credit cards, or if I need to pay in cash for purchases under a certain amount.
sentences.zh: 我想知道你們是否接受信用卡，還是低於某個金額的消費需要付現金。

sentences.en: The total seems higher than I expected, so could you break down the charges and explain each one to me?
sentences.zh: 總金額比我預期的高，你能把費用逐項列出並跟我解釋每一項嗎？

sentences.en: Is there a discount available if I buy three or more of these items, since I noticed the sign mentioned a bulk deal?
sentences.zh: 如果我買三個以上有折扣嗎？因為我注意到告示牌上提到有批量優惠。

sentences.en: I'd like to split the payment between two cards, putting half on each, if your system is able to handle that.
sentences.zh: 我想把付款分到兩張卡上，各付一半，如果你們的系統可以處理的話。

sentences.en: Do you offer any student discounts or promotional codes that I could apply to reduce the total price?
sentences.zh: 你們有提供學生折扣或可以用來降低總價的優惠碼嗎？

sentences.en: I just realized that I left my wallet at home, so is it possible to pay using a mobile payment app instead?
sentences.zh: 我剛發現把錢包忘在家裡了，可以改用行動支付 App 付款嗎？

sentences.en: The price tag says twenty dollars, but I was charged twenty-five, which doesn't seem right — could you check that?
sentences.zh: 價格標籤寫二十元，但我被收了二十五元，這似乎不對——你能確認一下嗎？

sentences.en: Before I complete the purchase, could you confirm whether the warranty is included in the price or if it costs extra?
sentences.zh: 在我完成購買之前，能確認保固是包含在價格內還是需要額外付費？

sentences.en: I noticed that the item I purchased yesterday is now on sale, so I was wondering if I could get a price adjustment.
sentences.zh: 我注意到昨天買的東西現在在特價，我想知道能不能做價格調整。

sentences.en: Would it be cheaper to buy the bundle package, which includes all three products, rather than purchasing them individually?
sentences.zh: 買包含三樣產品的套裝組會比較便宜嗎？還是個別購買比較划算？

sentences.en: I have a gift card with some remaining balance on it — could you apply that first and then charge the rest to my card?
sentences.zh: 我有一張禮品卡上面還有餘額——你能先用那個，剩下的再刷我的卡嗎？

sentences.en: Excuse me, but I think you gave me the wrong change — I paid with a fifty, and the total was only thirty-two.
sentences.zh: 不好意思，我覺得你找錯錢了——我付了五十元，而總共只有三十二元。

sentences.en: Is it possible to get an itemized receipt that shows each product separately, since I need it for my expense report?
sentences.zh: 可以給我一張逐項列明每個產品的收據嗎？因為我需要用來報帳。

sentences.en: I'd prefer to pay in installments over three months, if that option is available for purchases above this amount.
sentences.zh: 我比較想分三期付款，如果超過這個金額的消費有提供這個選項的話。

sentences.en: The service charge, which was automatically added to the bill, seems unusually high — is that the standard rate here?
sentences.zh: 帳單上自動加的服務費看起來異常地高——這裡的標準費率是這樣嗎？

sentences.en: Could you please send the invoice to my email address, so that I have a digital copy for my records?
sentences.zh: 能請你把發票寄到我的電子信箱嗎？這樣我就有電子檔可以存檔。

sentences.en: I'm paying for everyone at this table tonight, so please put all the orders on a single bill under my name.
sentences.zh: 今晚這桌我請客，所以請把所有人的帳都開在一張單上算我的。

sentences.en: Is there a minimum purchase amount required to use a credit card, or can I charge any amount regardless of how small?
sentences.zh: 刷信用卡有最低消費金額的要求嗎？還是不管金額多小都可以刷？

sentences.en: I'd like to add a fifteen percent tip to the total, and then you can go ahead and process the payment on this card.
sentences.zh: 我想在總金額上加百分之十五的小費，然後你就可以用這張卡結帳了。

sentences.en: Since I'm buying in bulk for my office, would it be possible to negotiate a wholesale price on these supplies?
sentences.zh: 因為我是幫辦公室大量採購，有可能就這些用品談個批發價嗎？

sentences.en: The machine declined my card for some reason, but I'm certain there are sufficient funds — could you try running it again?
sentences.zh: 機器不知為何拒絕了我的卡，但我確定餘額足夠——你能再刷一次試試嗎？

sentences.en: I was charged twice for the same transaction, which I can clearly see on my bank statement — how can we resolve this?
sentences.zh: 同一筆交易我被扣了兩次款，我在銀行對帳單上看得很清楚——我們要怎麼處理？

sentences.en: Does the quoted price include shipping and handling, or will those be calculated separately at the time of checkout?
sentences.zh: 報價包含運費和處理費嗎？還是結帳時會另外計算？

sentences.en: I'd like to return this item and get a full refund back to my original payment method, if that's within your policy.
sentences.zh: 我想退貨並全額退款到原來的付款方式，如果這在你們的規定範圍內的話。

sentences.en: Could you apply my loyalty points to this purchase, which should give me a ten percent discount on the total?
sentences.zh: 你能把我的會員點數用在這次消費上嗎？應該可以讓總價打九折。

sentences.en: I wasn't expecting it to be this expensive, so let me reconsider my options and perhaps remove a few items from the order.
sentences.zh: 我沒預料到會這麼貴，讓我重新考慮一下，也許從訂單中移除幾樣東西。

sentences.en: Is there a way to set up automatic payments for my monthly subscription, so I don't have to remember each billing cycle?
sentences.zh: 有辦法設定月費訂閱的自動扣款嗎？這樣我就不用每個帳單週期都記得繳費。

sentences.en: I have a coupon that expired yesterday, but since I was planning to shop here anyway, is there any chance you'd still honor it?
sentences.zh: 我有一張昨天到期的優惠券，但既然我本來就打算來這裡買東西，有沒有可能還是讓我用？

sentences.en: The exchange rate seems unfavorable right now, so I'd rather pay in the local currency to avoid any additional conversion fees.
sentences.zh: 匯率現在看起來不太好，所以我寧願用當地貨幣付款以避免額外的轉換手續費。
